class.name: BulletSplitData2D
class.brief_description: A split chain: how bullets burst into children, generation by generation.
class.description: [member stages][code][d][/code] decides how the bullets of generation [code]d[/code] split (0 = the bullets a spawner fired, 1 = their children, ...). A generation without a stage never splits, so the chain is as deep as [member stages]. With [member repeat_last_stage] on, the generations past the last stage reuse it until [member max_depth]: [code]max(stages.size(), max_depth)[/code] generations split (every listed stage always splits, even past [member max_depth]). Arm it with [member BulletSpawner2D.split_data] (with [member BulletSpawner2D.split_enabled]) or [method BulletVolley2D.split_set_data]. Volleys read the chain when a bullet dies, so edits reach bullets already in flight. A dying bullet never spawns where it dies: its split is recorded and the [BulletFactory2D] spawns the children (one new volley per parent) right after the sweep, at the pose the parent died at; they move from the next sweep. Pool-safe: a pooled volley never keeps a chain.

method.name: apply_preset
method.description: Replaces [member stages] with a ready-made chain (see [enum Preset]) and turns [member repeat_last_stage] off.

method.name: create_preset
method.description: A new chain built from a preset.

method.name: get_generation_count
method.description: How many generations split: the size of [member stages], or [code]max(stages.size(), max_depth)[/code] while [member repeat_last_stage] is on (0 for an empty chain).

method.name: get_stage_for_depth
method.description: The stage that splits generation [param depth], or [code]null[/code] when that generation does not split (past the chain, an empty entry, a negative depth).

members.member: With [member repeat_last_stage] on: the last stage repeats until generation [code]max_depth - 1[/code] (1 to 64). It only extends the chain: every stage in [member stages] splits its generation even when the list is longer than [member max_depth]. Hidden while repeating is off.
When on, generations past the last stage reuse it, up to generation [code]max_depth - 1[/code] (see [method get_generation_count]).
One [BulletSplitStage2D] per generation. An empty entry stops the chain at that generation.

constants.constant: One ring of 8 when a bullet expires or is killed by a hit.
A ring of 6 (smaller), then each child fans into 3 (smaller and slower).
